notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44473778/d0f0b2eb29541a568f1a301b1816451bb7a994fe.png[/img]
[h3]Tree Planting & New Artificial Dungeon[/h3]
You can plant trees in Forster.
Also, you can build a harmless artificial dungeon with the dungeon core obtained after removing a dungeon.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44473778/37ca43c8a7f85c65b19e0e16d223d2b3a2a4230a.png[/img]
[h3]UI Rework[/h3]
The resources are shown in 2 columns.
The resources can be opened or closed in groups, and the resources UI window resizes accordingly.
Also, tooltip for building that had poor descriptions of adjacent bonus, such as farms is added.


[list]
[*] Localized citizen names (japanese, korean)
[*] Some natural features drop items when removed
[*] Increased starting resource amount (Herb, Clothes)
[*] Some bug fixes
[*] Demo updated
[/list]


After the upcoming Spring Sale, the price of the Pixel Colony will increase slightly.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44473778/009cd23198bfd65638f0486b0ce2454cb44e5474.png[/img]
[h3]Resource Exploration[/h3]
Add [b]resource exploration[/b] buildings.

Add [b]Large Well[/b], effective during droughts.

[h3]New Recipes[/h3]

Produce a lot of luxuries for your citizens.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44473778/2e3665245ba30e864289150fd35cf7536f321a0c.png[/img]
Now, You can change the priority of the buildings in batches.
You can also see the priority of the buildings at a glance.
Citizens are hired first in high-priority buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44473778/5423322c58dc0b678cc68b3bf8373ae2eb833998.png[/img]
A new advanced recipe
* Tailor
3 cottons + 2 fairy roses + 1 magic tools -> 6 fine clothes (workload 180)

And, change some recipes.
* Plantation
(Old)  1 herb (workload 45)
(New) 1 herb (workload 36)
=> Increase herbs production

* Tailor
(Old)  12 cottons + 1 tools -> 8 clothes (workload 180)
(New) 12 cottons + 1 tools -> 10 clothes (workload 180)
=> Increase clothes production

* Potion Maker
(Old)  4 herbs + 1 glass + 2 element dust  -> 10 red potions (workload 180)
(New) 5 herbs + 1 glass + 3 element dust  -> 15 red potions (workload 180)
=> Increase red potions production

Also, adjust prices of resources related to herbs. (beer, red potion)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44473778/2acb188e3c23ae3d22b54ab1c7e69306c26847ce.png[/img]
Add "Large Granary", which can store more foods.
When you complete the Professional Chefs research, you can build it.


[list]
[*] Mark contents newly unlocked by research as New icon
[*] Simple effect for unlocking research
[*] Like demolition, natural objects can be removed in batches
[*] Some icons changed (demolition, upgrade)
[*] Slightly improved performance (still working in progress)
[/list]
